name: Image Studio
description: Make and change pictures with the image models on this computer.

cards.title: Pictures from words.
cards.text: Describe a picture, and Image Studio makes it. Every picture stays in your library.

rows.title: Make
rows.text: Write what you want to see, then choose Make.

rows.title: Edit by words
rows.text: Say what to change, such as the season or the light.

rows.title: Fill and erase
rows.text: Brush over a part to put something new there, or to take it out.

rows.title: Extend
rows.text: Grow the picture past its edges, on the sides you pick.

rows.title: Enlarge
rows.text: Make a larger, sharper copy of a picture.

rows.title: Compare
rows.text: Make the same picture with two or more models, side by side.

rows.title: Before and after
rows.text: Slide a line across a changed picture to see how it was before.

rows.title: Cards and posters
rows.text: A watercolour fox for a birthday card.

rows.title: Holiday photos
rows.text: A stranger erased from the beach.

rows.title: Desktop pictures
rows.text: A portrait extended into a wide view.

tools.name: make
tools.title: Make pictures
tools.description: Runs one picture job and saves its pictures in the app's folder of the run.

tools.name: hold
tools.title: Read pictures
tools.description: Reads pictures of the library as assets a job or a model can take.

tools.name: release
tools.title: Release pictures
tools.description: Drops the assets a finished job read.

tools.name: keep
tools.title: Add a picture
tools.description: Adds a picture the person opened to the library.

tools.name: remove
tools.title: Delete pictures
tools.description: Deletes pictures of the library and their files.
